design.matched: All3 groups have identical heading, short/long window lengths, explicit bank, edge settings, source, ROI and empty masks. Primary/lateral origins differ by exactly+6 source normal pixels; bright group is translated to irregular bright terrain.
design.sourceProfileConstraint: Profiles remain frozen -30..30px at0.25px. Largest56px candidate and offset profiles may put edges near or beyond usable boundary; finite fits are not boundary-safety evidence. No later widening.
design.sensorSemantics: Dev72 observation is a point-pose sensor ignoring t0/t1. Five short origins move; long origin equals short3 so those two Dev72 values duplicate by design. JS profile windows differ. Never count window-length repetition as independent sensor evidence.

predictedObservations.prediction: If paired-edge evidence is locally sustained at a candidate width, each of the five short profiles and the matching long profile can retain a finite pair with compatible original-frame edges. Long-only finite pairing is expected to be possible through averaging and does not establish local continuity.

The+6 normal shift may change fixed Dev72 rail/interior channels. If exactly the same physical edge pair remains in both profiles and is selected, offset-minus-primary candidateCenterMinusFitMidpointPx should be+6px. Nulls, alternate pairs and field-of-view losses remain unaltered evidence, not zero offsets.

Broad irregular bright terrain can show finite pairs, long-only pairs, or stronger raw channels than primary. Comparable evidence demonstrates ambiguity; a weak control still cannot prove path identity.
The single visually proposed square/plaque segment may yield arbitrary diagnostic width; no width promotion/calibration or verified endpoint identity follows.

falsifiers.rejectIf: Any PNG/blob/fullRGBA mismatch; missing conservative support; changed ROI/frame/geometry/bank/settings/source; no measurements may be interpreted. Do not enlarge ROI or drop training.

For any candidate width, one or more short windows lack a finite positive two-edge fit while the long window has one: reject that candidate's long-average-as-sustained-local-pair assertion. If all short and long are null, paired-edge support is absent, not an accepted negative classifier.

Finite pairs transformed back to original source show inconsistent left/right/midpoint trajectories across windows. Report exact raw deltas; no newly selected tolerance, recentering, tracking or post-hoc accepted subset.

Any jointly finite primary/offset fit violates the ideal+6 midpoint contrast outside the existing fixed1e-9 numerical comparison; record raw discrepancy and UNKNOWN same-edge identity. If unavailable in either fit, comparison is UNKNOWN. This is a strict diagnostic, not an accuracy model.

Bright-organic matched controls yield comparable/stronger finite paired-edge evidence or channels. This supplies local photometric ambiguity; no channel cutoff, vote, classifier or semantic acceptance is allowed even if primary ranks highest.
Any crop/source raw field difference exceeds unchanged1e-9 absolute tolerance. Retain both receipts and UNKNOWN; never relax tolerance or change fitter.

reporting.retain: Both complete source/crop receipts; all54 candidate rows per composition; every short/long profile and visible count; all Dev72 lanes; all finite/null fits and original-frame edge/midpoint projections. Fit/null matrices are descriptive, not threshold/classifier.
prohibited: No later widening, recentering, masks, setting/width tuning or same-experiment reruns.
No semantic identity, calibrated width, scale, source-renderer identity, production promotion, AA benefit, acceptance or global classifier inference.
